rotulo: regional, 30 m (NASADEM); not field drainage design

rutas_depresiones.nota: No runoff path is drawn inside closed depressions of the elevation model that are this deep or deeper, nor on the short stretches left between two of them: there the 30 m model cannot tell where water leaves.

pendiente: per field: least-squares plane fitted to its NASADEM cells; area: elevation model smoothed over 5 x 5 cells (about 150 m) [S]

tormenta.definicion: 95th percentile of days with rain >= 1 mm
tormenta.fuente: NASA GPM IMERG V07 (NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V07), mean over the pilot area rectangle

contraste.fuente: NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR, pilot area point
